subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate OpenSSF Best Practices & Tooling into OpenClaw

question: Which remaining OpenSSF supply-chain controls should OpenClaw adopt now, which existing safeguards intentionally replace requested controls, and which parts should stay as GitHub or organization administration outside the source tree?
rationale: The remaining work changes CI trust, dependency gates, release identity, repository policy, and artifact verification, so automation cannot choose the permanent security posture or rollout order.

options.title: Split And Phase Selected Controls
options.body: Keep this umbrella open and split owner-approved slices for Scorecard/badges, SECURITY-INSIGHTS, scanner gates, release attestations, and org settings with validation per surface.

options.title: Keep As Tracking Only
options.body: Use this issue as a standing security roadmap tracker and require separate maintainer-authored issues or PRs before implementation starts.

options.title: Defer OpenSSF Program
options.body: Pause OpenSSF-specific adoption only if maintainers decide current SECURITY.md, Dependabot/Dependency Guard, CodeQL, provenance, and attestations are sufficient substitutes for now.

recommendation.title: Split And Phase Selected Controls
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella open and split owner-approved slices for Scorecard/badges, SECURITY-INSIGHTS, scanner gates, release attestations, and org settings with validation per surface.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the project lead listed in CONTRIBUTING, owns the CODEOWNERS routing rules, and already engaged on this cross-cutting tracker.
